entries: Owner decisions: grid profile, second stage, stop after stage 2. tools/joint_noise_stage.py: 105-member noise grid (no red or 5 strengths x 4 slopes; 5 white scales), threshold from five off-grid generators with 1024 calibration and 1024 validation nulls each. Matches September per-member objectives to 7e-10; direct-fit checks 8e-12; 3 unit tests.
Linear timing only. Stage 3 (nonlinear orbit, J2043) needs a new owner instruction.
